nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

## Character Replacement wiring
- **Load Source Video** feeds `<Video 1>` (motion/camera/action) and its audio.
- The **first frame** of that source video feeds `<Picture 1>`.
- **Load Character Reference** feeds `<Picture 2>`.
- The prompt is prefilled to tell H3 to preserve the source video's motion/scene while replacing the main character with `<Picture 2>`.

Requires **ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite** for `VHS_LoadVideo`.

## Turbo Character Replacement — simplified
- `<Picture 1>` = replacement character only.
- `<Video 1>` = source motion, camera, timing and scene.
- The automatic first-frame reference was removed to avoid identity mixing and the Turbo 3-vs-2 tensor mismatch seen with 2 images + 1 video.
- Turbo LoRA strength: **0.8**.
- Dedicated MiniMax H3 Turbo Sampler + **8 steps**.

- [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)

**diffusion_models**

- [minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors)

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)


## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   └── 📂 text_encoders/
│       └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

nodes.title: Prompt - FULL Character Replacement (Turbo)
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the elegant woman in <Picture 1>, featuring voluminous long crimson-red wavy hair adorned with golden rose hair ornaments, warm amber eyes, an elegant white evening gown with red lining and asymmetric cascading ruffles, a tailored black half-coat with gold epaulettes and tassels, a gold rose brooch at her collar, ornate gold waist chains, black thigh-high stockings, and black pointed-toe ankle boots with gold filigree and stiletto heels.

summary:
[reference generation] A 15-second horizontal 16:9 high-fashion anime editorial video featuring <Subject 1> in a series of dynamic, elegant fashion poses and master-level camera movements against clean, high-contrast graphic backgrounds.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5], [Shot 6], [Shot 7], [Shot 8]): fully_preserved - the character's facial features, crimson hair, gold ornaments, white-and-red layered gown, black tailored coat, waist accessories, and ornate boots are strictly maintained.

detailed_description:
The target video adopts a premium 2D anime high-fashion editorial style with crisp linework, flat cel shading, and bold graphic compositions combining crimson, ivory white, deep obsidian, and radiant gold accents.
[Shot 1] A close-up portrait centers on <Subject 1> against a minimalist ivory background accented by clean crimson brush strokes and fine gold geometric lines. Crimson hair cascades across her shoulder as she gazes forward with a calm, poised expression. The gold text "ASTRAL CHIC" appears in a refined editorial serif font across the upper corner.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.500, the camera pulls back into a medium three-quarter fashion shot. <Subject 1> smoothly adjusts the black tailored coat on her shoulder, letting the ruffled sleeves settle. The camera orbits slowly around her, emphasizing the contrast between her white gown and the black coat's gold tassels.
[Shot 3] At 00:03.000, rapid editorial cuts showcase high-detail accessories within crisp graphic borders: amber eyes framed by red lashes, golden rose brooch at the neck, waist chain clasps, layered ruffles, and gold filigree on her stiletto boots. The title "TIMELESS" flashes momentarily in clean typography.
[Shot 4] At 00:04.800, a fast fashion montage follows <Subject 1> across multiple framing angles: front profile, three-quarter back view revealing cascading crimson hair, and a low-angle tracking shot of her stiletto boots striking an obsidian reflective floor. Deep red and gold graphic elements frame her silhouettes.
[Shot 5] At 00:06.500, she performs an elegant partial spin, causing the voluminous red-and-white hemline and black coat to billow outward. The flowing fabric motion transitions into sweeping graphic crimson brush arcs across the frame.
[Shot 6] At 00:07.800, the camera tilts up from her ornate boots along the cascading dress ruffles, ornate waist chains, and bodice to a full-body hero composition. <Subject 1> rests one gloved hand gracefully against her waist, her hair shifting gently with controlled secondary motion.
[Shot 7] At 00:09.800, a lateral tracking shot follows <Subject 1> walking forward with poised runway grace. Her coat tassels sway and gown fabric floats rhythmically against a stark graphic backdrop of deep navy and gold constellation motifs.
[Shot 8] At 00:11.500, she turns smoothly toward the camera with a serene, confident smile as subtle gold light flares and geometric star vectors accent her silhouette. The camera pushes into a balanced medium-full portrait, freezing into a polished luxury fashion magazine layout. The masthead "ASTRAL CHIC" settles across the frame as the shot holds until 00:15.000.

overall_soundscape:
Crisp heel clicks against polished hard surfaces, delicate silk fabric rustling, and the faint metallic chimes of shifting gold chains.

non_diegetic_music:
Mid-tempo electro-symphonic fashion house track featuring crisp electronic drum beats, sweeping orchestral strings, subtle piano chords, and rhythmic basslines synchronized to cuts and camera movements.
